_status: DRAFT — NOT APPROVED. AM-68 is a proposed amendment; nothing reads this file while LEGALMIND_CAPABILITY_ROUTE is unset. See docs/00-project/CAPABILITY_MANIFEST_PROPOSAL.md and AB21_PROPOSED_AMENDMENTS.md.
_rule: AM-68 r4 — every entry names behaviour that is BUILT and covered by a test. No future, planned, roadmap, partial or speculative capability. Rule 7's discipline: an invented capability is as bad as an invented legal rule.

capabilities.text: Read a contract you upload as PDF or DOCX, keeping the document's own clause numbering rather than inventing one.
Compare an uploaded document against the organisation's ratified Company Standards.
Classify each Finding as a match, a deviation, missing, a conflict, or not evaluable — and show the evidence, fact, standard and rule behind it.
Summarise a review in three plain words — Accepted, Needs review, Not accepted.
Answer questions about an uploaded document, pointing at the passage each sentence came from.
Quote the organisation's approved position word for word, with its standard code, version and source clause.
Answer questions about the approved statute corpus, cited by Act and section.
Follow a conversation, so a follow-up like "what does that mean?" is understood as being about the previous question.
Say plainly when the available material does not answer a question, instead of guessing.
Record a Legal Decision on an evaluation, made by a person authorised to make one.
Escalate a Finding for a human ruling, and withdraw that escalation.
Compare two versions of the same contract, clause by clause.
Export a review as a PDF or DOCX report.
List a document's key obligations as a description of what it says.
Archive, restore, transfer or delete a contract, with every such act recorded in the audit trail.
Publish a configuration snapshot so past reviews stay reproducible against the configuration they ran under.

limits.text: I do not decide whether a document is acceptable, approve it, or advise whether to sign. I show the findings and the approved position; a person decides.
I do not draft or generate agreements.
I work with one document per conversation, and cannot compare two uploaded documents with each other.
I state no legal position that is not already in a ratified Company Standard, a published Legal Rule or an approved template.
Where no approved source answers a question, I say so rather than guessing.
